content: For a Secu red Rx I - PDU with SecOCAuthPduHeaderLength = 0 or not configured and DynamicLength of the referred global Pdu (see ECUC_EcuC_00078) is set to TRUE, the SecOC module shall extract the Authentic I - PDU by using the length provided by the lower layer.
